titles.title: กิ่งหลิวซ่อนเพลิงแค้น

description:
Hadrius, son of a high-ranking noble. He falls in love with Tiberius, a commoner who is his father's subordinate.

*"Hadrius. No matter what happens, you will love me just like you do now, right?"*

However, that love was a thoroughly calculated revenge, and eventually, the family falls into ruin. Having lost everything, Hadrius is sold to a brothel and lives as a male prostitute, falling into ruin while unable to trust either people or love, when he meets Maximus, a Roman war hero, as a customer.

*"Maximus. Please kill me. I want to be at peace now."*

---

*"I have never seen anyone as strong as you in my life. There will never be anyone like you. I know that very well."*

Hadrius regains his will to live by the side of a warm-hearted man, but—

*"Hardy, please... look at me. Without you, I am nothing anymore."*

Tiberius, realizing that he is alive, comes looking for him belatedly....

*"Did you sleep with him? How many times did you spread your legs?"*

---
